spots.name: Mount Glorious
bio_facts: Mount Glorious is a mountain (619 m) in the D'Aguilar Range and a rural locality in the City of Moreton Bay, about 41 km by road north-west of Brisbane CBD
Surrounding forest is part of Brisbane Forest Park and D'Aguilar National Park
Named after a remark about the view by Elizabeth Patrick at a 1915 picnic
